Conditions that apply: Work to an existing building; Site stays occupied or operating during the works.

### 2. Scope of services

You are the independent cost planner. Your job is to give the client a reliable picture of what the project will cost at every stage, so design decisions are made with the money in view and the budget holds.
To do this you:
- Price the design at each appointed stage and report against the budget.
- Show the cost of design options before the client chooses.
- Name the risks, allowances and gaps in the information, and say what would close them.
For the office or retail space, this separates base-building cost from tenant fit-out cost.
Because this is work to an existing building, this includes allowances for what will only be found once the building is opened up.
Your advice runs from our written instruction and complete inputs to the final output we name and the end of the query period. Show estimate uncertainty plainly; you do not guarantee a tender price, final cost, approval or funding.
Designers and specialists define the design, compliance, whether retained systems are adequate, and remediation. The operator supplies equipment and owner costs. The project manager approves the budget and changes. You price the gaps; the contract administrator directs and certifies; other advisers own tax, legal and valuation advice. Tell us about any conflict with the client, contractor or lender.
Cost basis: Confirm purpose/users; construction versus total-project boundary; currency/tax adviser, budget/date/approval, quality, measurement method, price date/location and escalation endpoints. Attach current revisions, contracts/quotes and conflicting identities/dates.

Confirm base stages, inputs and final query-period end; later services require written instruction. R1 Fee by stage: Price stages/options once: base/options/alternatives totals, fixed/time-ceiling/unit basis, quantities/GST/payments and dependent/standalone authority fees. Separate already-authorised work/ad hoc allowances. Confirm validity, numbered addenda and signatory authority. Price each included stage. A line marked Included is part of its stage fee; a line marked Excluded is not part of this appointment. Fees exclude GST; state GST and total in your proposal. Propose any departure in R6.

### 4. Allowances

Complete counts before issue. Fixed fee, time ceiling or unit rate with quantity; options separately totalled. Construction provisional sums do not authorise consultant fees.

| Item | Allowance |
|---|---|
| Plans / options | 2 cost issues; stages/buildings/packages, alternatives, maturity/quantity basis and total-project extent |
| Review / meetings | 2 feedback rounds; draft/final issues, meetings/duration, authority discussions and advice-hour ceiling |
| Visits / access | 2 visits/hours; sites/areas, access/induction/travel and named specialist investigations; no hidden-work verification |
| Tender services | 2 packages; bills/schedules/tenders, clarification/interview hours and reconciliation issues |
| Post-contract / completion | 2 months; claims/variations or hours ceiling, reports/visits, final-account rounds, defects/retention period and extension rates |
| Specialist options | 2 reports/scenarios; purpose/extent/horizon, drawdowns, reliance users and extra inputs/inspections |

### 5. Terms

- Agree Project cost appointment (attached), version/precedence and written departures; no unavailable standard terms or conflicting purchase-order terms by implication.
- Written authority before extra scope, ceilings/counts, later stages or fee/program change; give cause, alternatives and effects. Report material unpriced gaps/budget overruns promptly.
- Facts, revisions, selected stages, counts, positions and addenda set baseline; purchased design development/review is included.
- Correcting your own errors, or coordinating with information you were given, is not a variation.
- Correct invoices for completed work payable within 30 days, subject to agreement/applicable requirements. Disclose advance payment, interest, suspension, minimums and withholding.
- Agree rate-validity date and escalation, unused allowances, cancellation/standby and remobilisation; no inherited annual increase.
- Your proposal stays valid for 90 days.
- Send questions in writing to Project manager by 2026-10-23.
- Answers to scope questions go to every tenderer as numbered addenda.
- Dated PDFs/editable quantity/rate/reconciliation workbooks; source cutoff, units, rate evidence, preliminaries/margin, PC/PS, gaps, risk/escalation/tax and confidence limits. Agree project distribution licence, separate lender reliance, proprietary-data limits, confidentiality/security/retention and handover.
- Competent resources/independent review, substitutions/conflicts and selected insurance; disclose liability/indemnity/loss/novation/IP/contamination departures. Agree notice/cure, completed/committed costs, records transfer, negotiation/mediation and urgent relief.
